anti_overlap: fd-societal-layer-gap-ranking (existing) owns the FINAL cross-candidate ranking table and top-pick recommendation across all nine candidates (3 mandated axes + 6 comparators); this agent's job is the per-comparator existing-coverage audit and cost/host evidence that feeds that ranking, not a competing final ranking

fd-pace-layer-shearing-gap, fd-institutional-lifecycle-void, and fd-experiential-regime-gap each own one mandated seed axis in depth; this agent owns breadth across the six named comparators, not depth on any one of the three mandated axes
decision_lens: The inventory shows specific plausible partial-coverage candidates already in code: the dead CascadeConfig with trade/alliance/border sub-lists (config/types.rs:183-192, unwired, propagation_rate 0.20) as a natural finance/trade-contagion host; the 7 shock types including 'oil price [global]' and market volatility as partial energy/finance coverage; ResourceScarcity/EnvironmentalStress pressures and forcing curves as partial energy-system coverage; and no existing candidate host at all yet identified for organized crime, religion, or education as DISTINCT mechanisms (as opposed to their effects showing up diffusely in EliteFracture/CulturalEvolution/DemographicPressure). The test for each of the six comparators is the same discipline the target.md demands of information/media-ecology: audit existing partial coverage FIRST, name the specific residual gap only after that audit, and give the residual gap a concrete host and cost estimate — a comparator that skips this audit and proposes wholesale new mechanism is not comparably rigorous to one that does.
focus: Whether each named comparator candidate (finance/credit contagion, public health, energy systems, organized crime/illicit economies, religion, education/human capital) is first audited against what the existing 13-pressure lattice, 7 shock types, dead CascadeConfig, and soft pillars ALREADY partially cover, before being proposed as net-new — surfacing the genuinely cheapest-to-calibrate candidates the ranking table needs, not just the most theoretically interesting ones
name: fd-comparator-portfolio-coverage-audit
persona: Apply the perspective of a systems-portfolio triage analyst whose job is coverage-gap auditing across multiple candidate domains under a fixed calibration budget — the disposition of someone doing due diligence on acquisition targets, not a domain enthusiast advocating for any one system. The mandate is breadth and existing-infrastructure reuse: for six structurally disparate comparator domains (finance, public health, energy, organized crime, religion, education), the job is to determine, domain by domain, how much of each is already latent in existing code paths versus genuinely absent, and which absent slice has the cheapest plausible host.
review_areas: Whether finance/credit contagion is evaluated against the SPECIFIC existing dead-code host (CascadeConfig's trade/alliance/border NeighborConfig, config/types.rs:183-192 / defaults/cascades.rs) rather than treated as needing wholly new infrastructure — is 'wire up the dead config + add data' actually cheaper than the live 10-country NEIGHBOR_MAP extension, and what's the calibration risk of reviving previously-unwired code with a different propagation_rate (0.20 dead vs 0.05 live) than what's currently certified

Whether public health/pandemic is checked against the existing 'climate event' and general shock-roster machinery (7 shock types, shocks.rs:33-149, monthly probabilities/magnitudes) for how much of a pandemic-shock candidate could be a new 8th shock TYPE (cheap: reuses existing roster/probability/magnitude machinery and target-roster-of-10-majors pattern) versus requiring new per-country epidemiological state (expensive: SIR-style compartments with no existing analog)

Whether energy systems are checked against ResourceScarcity/EnvironmentalStress pressures AND the forcing curves (resource-tightening ramp, config/types.rs:33-107) for existing partial coverage before being proposed as a new pressure family — specifically whether an energy-grid-fragility candidate is actually a coupling/threshold modulator on ResourceScarcity's existing decay/cascade math (cheap) or requires genuinely new grid-topology state (expensive, no existing analog to a physical network graph)

Whether organized crime/illicit economies is recognized as having NO plausible existing host in the current inventory (unlike the other five comparators) — i.e. does the review correctly flag this as the comparator most likely to require net-new state (a parallel-governance/illicit-economy signal with no analog in EliteFracture, InternalSecurity's corruption_load, or Diplomacy) rather than force-fitting it onto an existing pillar to appear cheaper than it is

Whether religion is checked against cultural_evolution's slow axes (tradition/innovation, authority_acceptance) and ideology's 3-axis + conviction structure (ideology/types.rs:6-18) for whether a religion/civilizational-identity axis is already latently expressible as a specific parameterization of existing slow-drift state, versus requiring a distinct axis for specifically religious/sacred authority (distinguishable from general cultural conservatism or political ideology)

Whether education/human capital is checked against the information module's already-DEAD education sub-struct fields (enrollment_rate, quality_index — 2 of the 9 confirmed-dead fields in InformationNarrativePillar, inventory §7) as the cheapest possible host — i.e. can education/human-capital coverage be achieved by reviving already-seeded-but-unread dead fields and wiring them to a pressure, which would be dramatically cheaper than any other comparator's introduction path

severity_examples.condition: Violates the target.md's explicit mandate (modeled on the same scrutiny already applied to information/media-ecology) that existing coverage be audited before any candidate is proposed as net-new — proposing net-new without the audit inflates the apparent calibration cost and misinforms the f-007 ranking table
severity_examples.scenario: Finance/credit contagion, public health, or energy is recommended as a brand-new 14th+ pressure family or wholly new mechanism without first checking the specific existing partial-coverage candidates named in the inventory (dead CascadeConfig, existing shock types, ResourceScarcity/forcing curves respectively)

severity_examples.condition: The dead-field revival path is categorically cheaper (no new state definition, no new RNG stream, only a new pressure-emission wiring) than every other comparator's plausible path, and omitting it from consideration understates education's ranking-table competitiveness
severity_examples.scenario: Education/human capital is proposed as requiring new state when the two confirmed-dead fields (enrollment_rate, quality_index in InformationNarrativePillar's Education sub-struct) are never checked as a candidate host — missing what is very likely the single cheapest comparator introduction path in the entire portfolio (reviving dead-but-already-seeded fields vs. any new-state proposal)

severity_examples.condition: Same rigor cuts both ways: existing-coverage claims must be as scrutinized as existing-coverage denials — a false-cheap claim is as damaging to the ranking table as a false-expensive one
severity_examples.scenario: Organized crime is force-fit onto InternalSecurity's corruption_load or EliteFracture as 'already covered' to make it look cheap, when in fact those signals are diffuse proxies with no distinct parallel-governance/illicit-economy state — collapsing a structurally distinct comparator into an existing scalar it doesn't actually represent

severity_examples.condition: Interaction effects across comparators, not just each comparator's isolated cost, matter for the f-007 ranking table's portfolio-allocation logic per the target.md's calibration-cost mandate
severity_examples.scenario: Religion and education are each evaluated in isolation without checking whether they interact (e.g. religious authority structures historically gate education access/curriculum), which could change relative calibration cost if introduced together vs. separately

success_hints: Reward a per-comparator existing-coverage audit (what fraction of finance/health/energy/crime/religion/education is already latent in current code, cited file:line) BEFORE any net-new proposal, applied with equal rigor across all six — not just the ones with an obvious host

Reward correctly identifying education (dead Education sub-struct fields) and finance (dead CascadeConfig) as the two comparators with the cheapest plausible introduction path (revive+wire dead state) versus organized crime as the comparator most likely requiring genuinely new state

Reward a concrete calibration-cost tier and code host per comparator (not a single bundled verdict for 'the comparators'), each usable as its own row in the f-007 ranking table alongside the three mandated seed-axis candidates

Reward flagging cross-comparator interaction effects (e.g. finance contagion and energy systems both wanting to reuse cascade/neighbor infrastructure — do they compete for the same T0-dispersion budget if both are added) as the target.md's calibration-cost mandate requires

Penalize treating any comparator's 'cheap because reuses existing infra' claim as free of calibration cost — reviving dead code (CascadeConfig, dead Education fields) still requires referee re-proof and band re-confirmation per B7 discipline, just less of it than new state
task_context: What societal-dynamics layers and world systems is shadow-work missing? Keep the portfolio-ranking mandate live throughout: every candidate layer must name a concrete code host and a calibration-cost estimate under B7 discipline, feeding the f-007 ranking table. Comparators in scope: finance/credit contagion, public health, energy, organized crime, religion, education.
